source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style long-running search needs auditable restore and replay evidence that separates accepted experiment state from diagnostic quarantine rows and from provider/controller payloads that are not replayed.

implemented_runtime_evidence.runtime_run_artifact_bundle_report_schem: runtime.run_artifact_bundle_report links accepted streams, quarantine diagnostics, non-JSONL policy, and paper artifacts
implemented_runtime_evidence.accepted_stream_manifest_validation: restore/show readers validate manifest-advertised accepted streams
implemented_runtime_evidence.quarantine_stream_manifest_validation: restore/show readers validate manifest-advertised quarantine streams
implemented_runtime_evidence.accepted_quarantine_boundary_validation: restore certification records quarantine rows as diagnostics, not replayed state
implemented_runtime_evidence.cli_restore_certification_validation: CLI restore flags reject restore-certification overclaims before run
implemented_runtime_evidence.direct_runtime_restore_loader_validation: direct runtime restore loaders validate the certification report
implemented_runtime_evidence.direct_archive_restore_loader_validation: direct archive restore loaders validate the certification report
implemented_runtime_evidence.artifact_payload_reconstruction_exclusio: artifact payload reconstruction is outside current certification
implemented_runtime_evidence.compatible_resume_surface_certification: compatible_resume_ready remains true for supported manifest surfaces

claim_boundary: This boundary records that runtime.restore_certification validates compatible local manifest restore surfaces, run-artifact bundle report linkage, accepted-stream validation, quarantine-diagnostic validation, show-time rejection, CLI restore rejection, direct runtime restore-loader rejection, direct archive restore-loader rejection, and the explicit separation of quarantine diagnostics from accepted state. It does not claim full replay proof, provider raw-payload replay, controller pending-work checkpoint replay, artifact payload reconstruction hashes, cross-run restore/replay evidence, or independent restore/replay audit.
